scientific_defect.description: The frozen base Tuesday Stage-1 screen constrained full-window winner concentration but lacked the project-standard catastrophic-tail veto and did not test whether each chronological half stayed positive after removing its single best scored session. A candidate could therefore pass while one half depended on one winner or contained an economically catastrophic loss.

project_alignment.principle: Apply stricter pre-outcome project risk vetoes without changing the source hypothesis, weekday, asset, execution boundaries, cost ladder, sample schedule, minimum-power floor, or protected-evidence boundary.

risk_overlay.independent_event_unit: one scored Tuesday 00:00 UTC to Wednesday 00:00 UTC session

catastrophic_tail_veto.rule: absolute worst 48-bps net session loss <= 50% of the sum of positive 48-bps net session returns

single_winner_dependence_veto.rule: remove the single best 48-bps net session; remaining mean net bps must stay strictly positive

risk_overlay.observed_failure_precedence: An actually observed catastrophic-tail or single-winner-dependence failure is rejecting even if the remaining sample would otherwise be underpowered; data/PIT violations remain fail-closed.

next_transition: After exact-head CI and legitimate independent scientific/review admission, the guarded runner—not the base runner alone—is the only allowed Stage-1 execution path for this replication. It still cannot mint Stage-2, profitability, promotion, broker, or trade authority.
